properties.summary: Land-use districts traced from Figure 2-1 of the City of Cloverdale's draft Esmeralda Specific Plan (Version 7, revised Sept 29, 2026), which the Planning Commission heard on Oct 1, 2026 and the City Council has not yet adopted. Six zones are drawn: village mixed use and village hospitality around the entry, village residential split into its two height groups, and open space recreation and conservation, mostly east of the SMART rail line and along the Russian River. The plan's publicly accessible circulation parcels (streets and paths) and the SMART corridor aren't zones and are left out, and the overlays (restricted use, airport, piazza, hilltop, amphitheater) aren't drawn; no buildings are drawn.
properties.note: Land-use districts from the draft 2026 specific plan, not yet adopted; zones, not buildings.

properties.label: Village mixed use (VMU)
properties.source: traced: Draft Esmeralda Specific Plan, Version 7 (City of Cloverdale, Sept 25, 2026; posted as revised 9/29/26), Figure 2-1, Land Use Districts, p. 16 (PDF p. 22)
properties.note: Draft specific plan land use, not yet adopted. Retail, restaurants, hotel, offices, maker space, childcare and all housing types around the Entry Circle; up to 35 ft, net FAR 2.5, 10-30 homes per acre (senior housing 60) (Table 2-1, p. 18; Table 2-2, p. 20). Heights are subject to the Airport Safety Zones and FAA Part 77 overlays, which can lower them. About 15.1 acres as drawn.

properties.label: Village hospitality (VH)
properties.source: traced: Draft Esmeralda Specific Plan, Version 7 (City of Cloverdale, Sept 25, 2026; posted as revised 9/29/26), Figure 2-1, Land Use Districts, p. 16 (PDF p. 22)
properties.note: Draft specific plan land use, not yet adopted. The resort hotel with its spa, event and conference space, dining and shared parking, plus homes and the Piazza; up to 50 ft for the hotel and other non-residential uses, 35 ft for homes; net FAR 0.3, 5 homes per acre (Table 2-1, p. 18; Table 2-2, p. 20). Mapped to commercial: hotel-led. Part of it is in the Restricted Use Overlay (no homes, schools or day care without further cleanup) and the airport's safety zones. Heights are subject to the Airport Safety Zones and FAA Part 77 overlays, which can lower them. About 33.5 acres as drawn.

properties.label: Village residential (VR-1, VR-2)
properties.source: traced: Draft Esmeralda Specific Plan, Version 7 (City of Cloverdale, Sept 25, 2026; posted as revised 9/29/26), Figure 2-1, Land Use Districts, p. 16 (PDF p. 22)
properties.note: Draft specific plan land use, not yet adopted. Detached and attached homes, senior housing and small neighborhood uses; up to 35 ft, net FAR 1.0, 4-20 homes per acre (Table 2-1, p. 18; Table 2-2, p. 20). Heights are subject to the Airport Safety Zones and FAA Part 77 overlays, which can lower them. About 18.2 acres as drawn.

properties.label: Village residential (VR-3 to VR-5)
properties.source: traced: Draft Esmeralda Specific Plan, Version 7 (City of Cloverdale, Sept 25, 2026; posted as revised 9/29/26), Figure 2-1, Land Use Districts, p. 16 (PDF p. 22)
properties.note: Draft specific plan land use, not yet adopted. Detached and attached homes, senior housing and small neighborhood uses; up to 25 ft, net FAR 0.75, 4-15 homes per acre (Table 2-1, p. 18; Table 2-2, p. 20). VR-5A and VR-5B, east of the rail line, are an optional housing area. Heights are subject to the Airport Safety Zones and FAA Part 77 overlays, which can lower them. About 21.2 acres as drawn.

properties.label: Open space recreation (OSR)
properties.source: traced: Draft Esmeralda Specific Plan, Version 7 (City of Cloverdale, Sept 25, 2026; posted as revised 9/29/26), Figure 2-1, Land Use Districts, p. 16 (PDF p. 22)
properties.note: Draft specific plan land use, not yet adopted. Sports fields, playgrounds, picnic areas, gardens, farming and trails, including the 4.75-acre public sports park (OSR-1); an amphitheater only with a use permit; structures up to 15 ft (Table 2-1, p. 18; Table 2-2, p. 20). Heights are subject to the Airport Safety Zones and FAA Part 77 overlays, which can lower them. About 38.6 acres as drawn.

properties.label: Open space conservation (OSC)
properties.source: traced: Draft Esmeralda Specific Plan, Version 7 (City of Cloverdale, Sept 25, 2026; posted as revised 9/29/26), Figure 2-1, Land Use Districts, p. 16 (PDF p. 22)
properties.note: Draft specific plan land use, not yet adopted. Habitat protection and restoration along the Russian River and in the groves, with trails and small utility structures; up to 15 ft, tree houses in the Hilltop Overlay up to 20 ft (Table 2-1, p. 18; Table 2-2, p. 20). The plan puts the district at 123 acres (Table 2-2 note; Figure 2-2 on p. 21 says 93.4). Heights are subject to the Airport Safety Zones and FAA Part 77 overlays, which can lower them. About 117.3 acres as drawn.
